01 Coaching

You never train alone here.

Coaches walk the floor in every session. Ask about a lift, a machine or a plan and someone will show you, set it up and watch your first reps.

Floor coaches every shiftHelp with setup, spotting and form, no booking needed.
A plan built around your goalStrength, fat loss, a race, or a back that stops aching.
Progress you can seeRegular check-ins so you know what's working.

03 HYROX & functional

Eight stations. Eight runs.

Station 1 of 8 · after a 1 km run SkiErg 1,000 m

A HYROX race is a 1 km run, then a station, eight times over. Our sled track, turf and rig let you practise every piece of it at race pace.

8 km of running in a full raceSled track · functional turf · rig · tyres · carriesOpen-division distances shown
04 MMA & boxing
The fight room

A dedicated combat zone with heavy bags, pads and coaches who've been in the ring. First jab or fight camp, you'll be coached at your level.

BoxingMMABag workPads & sparringAll levels
05 – 06 Studios

Two studios, opposite moods.

Breathe out the workday.

An open studio with a real instructor. Every posture has an easier version, so stiff hips and first-timers are welcome.

Cardio you'll look forward to.

High-energy dance workouts to loud music. You don't need to know the steps; you'll pick them up by the second song.
